notes: Boeing 702 bus low-power station keeping mode

notes: Boeing 702 bus high-power orbit insertion mode

name: NSTAR
notes: Deep Space 1 throttle level 15; engine input power. Over 16000 h in flight and 30252 h in the JPL Extended Life Test. Mass from S28

name: NEXT PM1
notes: 36 cm beam diameter; full-power point. Peak Isp of 4310 s occurs near 4.0 kW

name: T5 UK-10
notes: Artemis EITA system; used for unplanned orbit raising

name: RIT-10
notes: Artemis RITA system; radio-frequency discharge

name: mu10 ECR
notes: Hayabusa; 4.2 GHz electrodeless microwave discharge. Input power derived from quoted thrust, Isp and total efficiency

name: ETS-VIII 12-cm Kaufman
notes: Midpoint of quoted 20.9-23.2 mN, 2402-2665 s and 46-50 percent ranges. Input power derived

name: T6
notes: BepiColombo; 22 cm Kaufman. Envelope 30-230 mN, qualified 75-145 mN

name: HiPEP
notes: Downrated point; 9620 s reached at 39.3 kW. Efficiency derived, consistent with quoted >72 percent between 6000 and 10000 s

name: NPT30-I2
notes: First in-orbit demonstration of iodine electric propulsion (S11). Thrust 0.3-1.1 mN, power 35-65 W, total impulse up to 5500 Ns. Mass is full wet system, not thruster dry mass. Efficiency derived

name: SPT-50
notes: Fakel SPT family

name: SPT-70
notes: Fakel SPT family

name: SPT-100
notes: Efficiency is the value averaged over thruster life at 300 V and 4.5 A discharge

name: SPT-140
notes: Psyche primary propulsion; qualified over 0.9-4.5 kW with 5-16 mg/s xenon flow (S09)

name: PPS-1350-G
notes: SMART-1 primary propulsion; flown throttled 462-1190 W, about 5000 h and 82 kg xenon processed

name: HERMeS AEPS
notes: Magnetically shielded; design life 50 kh at Isp up to 3000 s (S07). Baselined for the Gateway Power and Propulsion Element. Efficiency derived

name: X3 nested-channel Hall
notes: Peak thrust point 5.4 N at 99 kW and 400 V. Reported envelope: 1800-2650 s Isp and 0.54-0.67 efficiency over 5-102 kW. Isp derived at the quoted thrust, power and upper efficiency so the row is self-consistent

name: MAI lithium AF-MPD 32 kW
notes: Moscow Aviation Institute applied-field MPD. Thrust derived. Quoted efficiency excludes solenoid and vaporiser power

name: MAI lithium AF-MPD 150 kW
notes: Thrust derived. Quoted efficiency excludes solenoid and vaporiser power

name: MAI lithium AF-MPD 200 kW
notes: Best reliably reported AF-MPD point in the 200-500 kW range. Thrust derived. Efficiency excludes solenoid and vaporiser power

name: VASIMR VX-200
notes: Helicon source plus ion cyclotron heating and magnetic nozzle; 1-2 minute pulses. VX-200SS later ran 88 h continuous at 80 kW (S16). Thrust derived

name: Pewee
notes: Project Rover; 503 MWt at 2550 K, average core power density 2340 MWt/m3. Thrust not recorded in the cited source

name: Phoebus-2A
notes: Most powerful reactor ever built; above 4000 MWt for twelve minutes. Measured Isp 820 s, projected flight value 825-850 s

name: NASEM reference NTP
notes: Not hardware. Study reference point: Isp at least 900 s with hydrogen heated to at least 2700 K
